symptom: Legitimate browser login rejected with Start sign-in from this Nexus site.

reproductions.before: Two focused route checks returned 403 instead of 303
cases: Provider callback override differs from global public base URL
Explicit default HTTPS port omitted by browser Origin

fix: Validate the selected provider callback origin
Normalize host casing and default HTTP(S) ports
Reject foreign/opaque/malformed origins and cross-site Fetch Metadata
Ignore client-forwarded host/protocol headers for origin authorization
Preserve Secure cookies behind HTTPS-to-HTTP proxy and on session refresh
